# PublicAPI flag documentation behavior (2025-12-23 07:03Z)

_**User (2025-12-23 07:03Z)**_

I need some help to test the new `--publicAPI` flag.

`dist` and `documentation` and `node_modules` cannot be pushed to the github repository and this is ok.

In order for the test to pass we will need the fixture to be built before executing the test.

The fixture is @test/fixtures/library 

The test should check both use cases, using the `--publicApi` flag and not using the `--publicApi`.

When the `--publicApi` flag is set to true it should not document `getDefaultApiRoot`@test/fixtures/library/libs/my-lib/core/src/utils.ts and shoud not document `getDefaultApiRoot` @test/fixtures/library/libs/my-lib/data/src/utils.ts .

When the `--publicApi` flag is not set it should document them.

This is a more robust test that correctly handles the expected behavior when using the `--publicApiOnly` flag with a library that has no publicly exported functions.
